name: Recordati Industria Chimica e Farmaceutica S.p.A.
quirks: Consolidated statements are declared in EUR thousands; narrative/highlights quote millions. core_metrics and CSV are normalized to millions.
FY2015-FY2018 exist only as highlights tables in the preliminary results releases -- income statement metrics only, no balance sheet/cash flow/EPS.
EPS is in euros, not cents.
Shares outstanding = 209,125,156 issued (EUR 0.125 nominal on EUR 26,140,644.50 capital) less treasury; filings give weighted-average basic, which differs.
Live CVC/GBL take-private tender offer at EUR 51.29 ex-div (EUR 52.00 cum-div); acceptance period 31-Aug-2026 to 15-Oct-2026. Valuation is deal-pinned, not a standalone DCF.
CapEx is lumpy and M&A-driven (FY2024 EUR 851m Enjaymo rights vs FY2025 EUR 85m); reported FCF materially overstates owner FCF.
